title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Final-Month Tenure Courtesy on the All-Inclusive Utility Package Fee
content:
# Final-Month Tenure Courtesy — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Term.** A final-month tenure courtesy reduces the prorated final package fee of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

- by **10%** (0.10) when the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 36 whole months before the service end date;
- by **5%** (0.05) when it lies at least 24 but fewer than 36 whole months before it;
- by **nothing** (0.0) otherwise.

The reduced fee is the prorated final package fee times one less the courtesy, rounded half up to the cent.

## Tenure bands

| Whole months from move-in to the service end date | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 10% |
| 24 to 35 | 5% |
| fewer than 24 | none |

## Cases (hypothetical prorated fee of $80.75)

- Move-in 2023-06-30, service end 2026-06-30: 36 whole months, 10%; $72.675 becomes $72.68.
- Move-in 2023-07-01, service end 2026-06-30: 35 whole months, 5%; $76.7125 becomes $76.71.
- Move-in 2024-08-15, service end 2026-06-30: 22 whole months, none; $80.75.
